const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /tmp/repair_w60_verify.py
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path("/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation")
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
+
+from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
+from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
+from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
+
+BASE = "281ad0eff272259bf8c0bf67670c35a0ba7b7353"
+TASK = ROOT / ".ai/task/repair-w60-20261001"
+
+
+def git_blob(path: str) -> bytes:
+    return subprocess.run(
+        ["git", "show", f"{BASE}:{path}"],
+        cwd=ROOT,
+        check=True,
+        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+    ).stdout
+
+
+def comparable(record: dict) -> dict:
+    value = dict(record)
+    value.pop("logical_path", None)
+    return value
+
+
+workset = json.loads((TASK / "WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["items"]
+loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
+base_doc = loader.load_bytes(git_blob("mod-tome.lua"), logical_path="mod-tome.lua")
+current_doc = loader.load_path(ROOT / "mod-tome.lua", logical_path="mod-tome.lua")
+assert len(base_doc.records) == len(current_doc.records)
+
+workset_indices: dict[int, str] = {}
+for item in workset:
+    matches = [
+        index
+        for index, record in enumerate(base_doc.records)
+        if record.get("kind") == "translation"
+        and record.get("section") == item["section"]
+        and record.get("source") == item["source"]
+        and record.get("source_tag") == item["source_tag"]
+        and record.get("args_order") == item["args_order"]
+        and record.get("target") == item["target_preimage"]
+    ]
+    assert len(matches) == 1, (item["entry_revision_identity"], matches)
+    workset_indices[matches[0]] = item["entry_revision_identity"]
+assert len(workset_indices) == 6
+
+changed_indices: list[int] = []
+for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(base_doc.records, current_doc.records)):
+    if comparable(before) != comparable(after):
+        changed_indices.append(index)
+        before_without_target = comparable(before)
+        after_without_target = comparable(after)
+        before_without_target.pop("target", None)
+        after_without_target.pop("target", None)
+        assert before_without_target == after_without_target, index
+
+assert set(changed_indices) == set(workset_indices)
+
+placeholder = re.compile(r"%(?:\d+\$)?[-+ #0]*(?:\d+|\*)?(?:\.(?:\d+|\*))?[hlL]?[diuoxXfFeEgGaAcspq%]")
+markup = re.compile(r"#\{[^}]+\}#|\[(?:/?[biu]|/?color(?:=[^\]]+)?)\]")
+for index in changed_indices:
+    before = base_doc.records[index]["target"]
+    after = current_doc.records[index]["target"]
+    assert before.count("\n") == after.count("\n")
+    assert [len(line) - len(line.lstrip("\t")) for line in before.split("\n")] == [
+        len(line) - len(line.lstrip("\t")) for line in after.split("\n")
+    ]
+    assert placeholder.findall(before) == placeholder.findall(after)
+    assert markup.findall(before) == markup.findall(after)
+
+confirmed_revision = "1ebce25bfc96776d0baba0c17448747471b9b6bc02acf02d58b47f8fd2925219"
+confirmed_index = next(index for index, revision in workset_indices.items() if revision == confirmed_revision)
+before_target = base_doc.records[confirmed_index]["target"]
+after_target = current_doc.records[confirmed_index]["target"]
+expected_after = before_target.replace(
+    "当你进入深岩元素形态时，你获得",
+    "处于深岩形态时，你获得",
+    1,
+).replace("在深岩元素形态下", "在深岩形态下", 1)
+assert after_target == expected_after
+assert after_target.split("\n")[0] == "处于深岩形态时，你获得 %d%% 流血、毒素、疾病和震慑免疫。"
+assert after_target.split("\n")[1] == "\t\t技能等级 5 或以上时，在深岩形态下，你将用物理抗性取代其他伤害抗性。"
+
+term_edits = json.loads((TASK / "TERM-EDITS.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+term_base_bytes = git_blob("terminology/talents.tsv")
+term_current_bytes = (ROOT / "terminology/talents.tsv").read_bytes()
+assert term_base_bytes.endswith(b"\n") == term_current_bytes.endswith(b"\n")
+expected_lines = term_base_bytes.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
+insertions = 0
+replacements = 0
+for edit in term_edits:
+    if edit["old"] is None:
+        positions = [i for i, line in enumerate(expected_lines) if line == edit["insert_before"]]
+        assert len(positions) == 1
+        expected_lines.insert(positions[0], edit["new"])
+        insertions += 1
+    else:
+        positions = [i for i, line in enumerate(expected_lines) if line == edit["old"]]
+        assert len(positions) == 1
+        expected_lines[positions[0]] = edit["new"]
+        replacements += 1
+expected_term_bytes = ("\n".join(expected_lines) + ("\n" if term_base_bytes.endswith(b"\n") else "")).encode("utf-8")
+assert term_current_bytes == expected_term_bytes
+assert insertions == 1 and replacements == 1
+
+result = {
+    "baseline": BASE,
+    "records_total": len(base_doc.records),
+    "translations_total": len(base_doc.translations),
+    "changed_targets": len(changed_indices),
+    "changed_revision_keys": sorted(workset_indices[index] for index in changed_indices),
+    "changed_set_exact": True,
+    "non_target_fields_unchanged": True,
+    "lf_tab_placeholder_markup_invariants": True,
+    "confirmed_before": before_target,
+    "confirmed_after": after_target,
+    "mod_tome_sha256": hashlib.sha256((ROOT / "mod-tome.lua").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+    "terminology_exact_insertions": insertions,
+    "terminology_exact_replacements": replacements,
+    "terminology_other_lines_unchanged": True,
+    "terminology_sha256": hashlib.sha256(term_current_bytes).hexdigest(),
+}
+print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
